name: Horikawa Sunao
source: A mischievous classmate of Miki, Kae and Hina, as well as one of the Genki's students. She likes to tease all the above, and attacking them in tandem with Akemi. However, her physical form is at a fairly low level, when it comes to swimming.
translation: A mischievous classmate of Miki, Kae and Hina, as well as one of the Genki's students. She likes to tease all the above, and attacking them in tandem with Akemi. However, her physical form is at a fairly low level, when it comes to swimming.
